summary: US strikes on Iran drove a broad risk-off session: WTI +4.53%, VIX +9.52%, 10yr yield spike. All four indices red, regime downgraded to Neutral Bull. Gold fell -2.49% as the haven bid was absent; energy and defensives led while semis/software/crypto sold. RS leadership rotated into biotech. DELL -6.80% session then +7.89% AH on raised FY2027 AI-server guidance.
